mentions.name: Chof
mentions.description: A mobile app described as "Vivino, but for Chocolate bars" that lets users scan, save, and rate chocolate bars they find. It is currently in test phase and being submitted for App Store approval, with a scanning flow built using Gemini 3 Flash.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Vivino, but for Chocolate bars. App is called Chof, currently in test phase, and submitting for app store approval this week.
Scanning, saving, rating bars that you find.

I got to a pretty stable scanning flow using Gemini 3 flash.
